content.text: Submitted. The repaired fallback proposal now: (1) deletes the open-ended "substantially similar products/companies" scope and adds the 12-month outside cap in a single tightly anchored same-sentence edit (official ratio and word-expansion gates pass), and (2) adds one concise 6.1.1 carve-out for internal development and acquisitions — with the flagged surplus wording ("any products other than Deerskin Products through any channel", "Nothing in this Section 6.1 shall restrict the Company from", "or merged with", "or any of its affiliates") removed. All five fallback elements are mapped exactly once, and the locked "deviation" status is unchanged.
